conceptual assets.information: The aggregate run-enable setting, indicating whether any enable request is active and allowing the divider to generate downstream clock-enable events. The clock generator's operation depends on this setting.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity: this sensitive clock-control setting is sampled into the internal enable state at line 129, so changing the request changes the generator's behavior. Availability: the enable state controls whether the divider advances or is cleared at lines 130-134, suppressing the output enables at lines 140-147 and potentially stopping downstream logic.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could alter enable_i so the divider is disabled or enabled at the wrong time, causing downstream clocked logic to operate incorrectly or stall.

conceptual assets.information: The divided clock-enable pulse train delivered on clk_en_o, used to pace or enable downstream clocked logic. It has no value-carrying entry port because the pulses are generated internally from the divider state; enable_i only decides whether generation proceeds.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity: these sensitive clock-control outputs are produced by the divider logic at lines 140-147, and altering the generated levels can make downstream state advance incorrectly. Availability: withholding the output pulses prevents downstream clocked logic from receiving its required enable events, while lines 130-134 can stop the divider that produces them.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could manipulate the clock-enable control path so the output emits missing, extra or mistimed pulses, corrupting or blocking downstream operation.

considered, not kept.reason: The Clocks and resets rule excludes reset inputs, reset-chain copies and outputs, and synchronizer or release state, as implemented at lines 42-73.
The Clocks and resets rule excludes clk_i as a conceptual asset because it only times assignments at lines 122-128.
The Pacing pulses rule excludes cnt and cnt2 because they only pace the generated output pulses, as shown by lines 131-147.
The Build-time values rule excludes NUM_EN because it only fixes the enable_i width at lines 102-108 and cannot be changed at run time.
